payload.title: Move the replay audit out of the Amplify deploy
payload.description: The Amplify build runs bd replay (about 4 minutes of re-scoring the committed answers; no model inference) and fails the deploy when any studies/ file differs. Author's direction: CI in Amplify is not for evaluations. Amplify builds only: fast specs, bd report --json from the committed studies/, and the Astro build. The replay audit moves to a GitHub Actions workflow (replay.yml) on push and pull request, on Linux, so reproducibility is still checked and visible without blocking the site.
